integrity: The proof identifies explicit equivariant contractions and homotopy pushouts. A standalone finite binary verifier is supplied and expressly not treated as an infinite or integral certificate.
scientific_limitations: The equivariant equivalence applies to ordinary iterated Mycielskians under natural lifts of original graph automorphisms, not arbitrary additional automorphisms or generalized multi-level variants. Base fixed spaces may be arbitrary independence-complex types. No independent certification or definitive novelty proof is claimed.
title: Equivariant suspension for iterated Mycielski independence complexes
